enum.name: ARRC_CC_STATE
enum.description: Companion computer mediator state.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_STATE_BOOT
entry.description: Engine process running, not ready yet.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_STATE_IDLE
entry.description: Engine ready, SDR not streaming.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_STATE_ACTIVE
entry.description: SDR streaming (RX, TX or RXTX) or an exclusive script running.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_STATE_ERROR
entry.description: Engine process not running, or the SDR in state ERROR.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_STATE_SHUTTING_DOWN
entry.description: Closing the data after MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_REBOOT_SHUTDOWN.

enum.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS
enum.description: Companion computer status flags.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_FC_LINK
entry.description: Autopilot heartbeat received recently.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_GCS_SEEN
entry.description: GCS heartbeat received recently.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_TIMESYNC_OK
entry.description: Clock mapped to the autopilot boot clock.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_UTC_VALID
entry.description: UTC known (from SYSTEM_TIME).

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_DISK_OK
entry.description: Data disk free space above the reserve: recording is possible.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_ENGINE_OK
entry.description: SDR engine process running.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_THERMAL_THROTTLE
entry.description: CPU thermal throttling.

entry.name: ARRC_CC_FLAGS_DISK_LOW
entry.description: Data disk free space at or below the warning level (20 % of its size by default): download and erase data. Recording continues down to the reserve.

enum.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE
enum.description: SDR engine state.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_OFF
entry.description: Device released.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_READY
entry.description: Device open, not streaming.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_RX
entry.description: Streaming, receiving.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_TX
entry.description: Streaming, transmitting (mode TX).

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_RXTX
entry.description: Streaming, receiving and transmitting (mode RXTX).

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_ERROR
entry.description: Device lost or refused; the engine looks for it again.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_RESETTING
entry.description: Device reset in progress (RESET_SOFT or RESET_HARD).

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_STATE_STARTING
entry.description: Stream starting.

enum.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS
enum.description: SDR status flags.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_DEVICE_PRESENT
entry.description: SDR device detected.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_FPGA_LOADED
entry.description: Device open with its FPGA configured.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_RX_ON
entry.description: RX stream running.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_TX_ON
entry.description: Transmitting.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_TX_ARMED
entry.description: TX armed (MAV_CMD_ARRC_TX_ARM) and its timeout not expired.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_RECORDING
entry.description: Recording to the data disk.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_REF_LOCKED
entry.description: Device PLL locked to the external 10 MHz reference (clock_ref EXT_10MHZ).

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_OVERRUN
entry.description: Overrun in the last status period.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_SATURATED
entry.description: ADC saturation in the last status period.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_PRI_LOCKED
entry.description: Pulse repetition tracker locked.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_SIMULATED
entry.description: Simulated device (no hardware).

enum.name: ARRC_SDR_MODE
enum.description: SDR operating mode. TX shares the RX frequency, waveform and PRF.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_MODE_RX
entry.description: Receive only.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_MODE_TX
entry.description: Transmit while armed; the RX stream keeps running.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_MODE_RXTX
entry.description: Receive and transmit while armed.

enum.name: ARRC_CONFIG_OP
enum.description: Direction of an ARRC_SDR_CONFIG or ARRC_SDR_MEAS_CONFIG message.

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_OP_SET
entry.description: GCS request to apply this configuration.

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_OP_APPLIED
entry.description: Configuration in effect (echo or report).

enum.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT
enum.description: Outcome of a configuration request, reported in the companion's echo (op=APPLIED).

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT_ACCEPTED
entry.description: Applied as requested.

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT_ADJUSTED
entry.description: Applied with values adjusted to what the hardware supports.

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT_REJECTED_RANGE
entry.description: Refused: a value out of range, or an unknown waveform, template, port profile or enum value; the configuration in effect is echoed.

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT_REJECTED_BUSY
entry.description: Refused: the engine is not running or cannot take the request now.

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT_REJECTED_INTERLOCK
entry.description: Refused by a safety interlock (protected band, duty, TX role).

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT_FAILED
entry.description: The device refused the configuration or the engine did not answer in time; the previous configuration stays in effect.

entry.name: ARRC_CONFIG_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED
entry.description: Reserved; the companion does not send it.

enum.name: ARRC_PORT_ID
enum.description: Physical RF port of the SDR (bladeRF 2.0 micro: two RX, two TX).

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ID_RX1
entry.description: RX port 1 (stream channel 0).

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ID_RX2
entry.description: RX port 2 (stream channel 1).

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ID_TX1
entry.description: TX port 1 (TX channel 0).

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ID_TX2
entry.description: TX port 2 (TX channel 1).

enum.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE
enum.description: What a port is used for; RX roles are 0-4, TX roles 10-11.

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE_OFF
entry.description: Port not used; all RX or all TX roles OFF in a config means take them from the port profile.

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE_COPOL
entry.description: Co-polarised channel: the measured channel (pwr_c, phi_c); RX needs one.

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE_XPOL
entry.description: Cross-polarised channel: pwr_x and phi_x relative to COPOL.

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE_REF
entry.description: Reference channel: streamed and recorded, not measured by the standard engine.

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE_AUX
entry.description: Auxiliary channel: streamed and recorded, not measured by the standard engine.

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE_TX_MAIN
entry.description: Transmit port; TX needs one.

entry.name: ARRC_PORT_ROLE_TX_AUX
entry.description: Second transmit port.

enum.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION
enum.description: Polarisation of the antenna on a port (port profile metadata).

entry.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION_UNKNOWN
entry.description: Not specified.

entry.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION_H
entry.description: Horizontal linear.

entry.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION_V
entry.description: Vertical linear.

entry.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION_RHCP
entry.description: Right-hand circular.

entry.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION_LHCP
entry.description: Left-hand circular.

entry.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION_SLANT45
entry.description: Linear, slanted 45 degrees.

entry.name: ARRC_POLARIZATION_SLANT135
entry.description: Linear, slanted 135 degrees.

enum.name: ARRC_RADAR_TX_POL
enum.description: Transmit polarisation mode of the radar under test (session metadata).

entry.name: ARRC_RADAR_TX_POL_UNKNOWN
entry.description: Not specified.

entry.name: ARRC_RADAR_TX_POL_H
entry.description: Horizontal.

entry.name: ARRC_RADAR_TX_POL_V
entry.description: Vertical.

entry.name: ARRC_RADAR_TX_POL_SHV
entry.description: Simultaneous H and V.

enum.name: ARRC_GAIN_MODE
enum.description: RX gain control; the standard engine measures with manual gain and adjusts any AGC request to MANUAL.

entry.name: ARRC_GAIN_MODE_MANUAL
entry.description: Fixed gain rx_gain_db; the only mode the standard engine measures with.

entry.name: ARRC_GAIN_MODE_AGC_SLOW
entry.description: Slow automatic gain control: adjusted to MANUAL (result ADJUSTED) when the mode uses RX, not applied otherwise.

entry.name: ARRC_GAIN_MODE_AGC_FAST
entry.description: Fast automatic gain control: adjusted to MANUAL (result ADJUSTED) when the mode uses RX, not applied otherwise.

entry.name: ARRC_GAIN_MODE_AGC_HYBRID
entry.description: Hybrid automatic gain control: adjusted to MANUAL (result ADJUSTED) when the mode uses RX, not applied otherwise.

enum.name: ARRC_CLOCK_REF
enum.description: Reference clock of the SDR.

entry.name: ARRC_CLOCK_REF_INTERNAL
entry.description: SDR internal oscillator.

entry.name: ARRC_CLOCK_REF_EXT_10MHZ
entry.description: External 10 MHz reference: the device PLL locks to it (ARRC_SDR_FLAGS_REF_LOCKED).

enum.name: ARRC_SAMPLE_FMT
enum.description: Sample format of the stream; the bladeRF backend streams SC16_Q11.

entry.name: ARRC_SAMPLE_FMT_SC16_Q11
entry.description: 16-bit I and Q, full scale 2048; the format the bladeRF backend streams and records.

entry.name: ARRC_SAMPLE_FMT_SC8_Q7
entry.description: 8-bit I and Q, full scale 128; accepted and stored, not implemented by the companion.

enum.name: ARRC_TX_TRIGGER
enum.description: When transmission starts once TX is armed; the companion implements FREE_RUN only.

entry.name: ARRC_TX_TRIGGER_FREE_RUN
entry.description: TX starts as soon as it is armed and the stream runs.

entry.name: ARRC_TX_TRIGGER_ON_COMMAND
entry.description: Reserved: accepted and stored, not implemented by the companion.

entry.name: ARRC_TX_TRIGGER_PPS
entry.description: Reserved: accepted and stored, not implemented by the companion.

enum.name: ARRC_SIGNAL_TYPE
enum.description: Kind of signal the standard measurement expects.

entry.name: ARRC_SIGNAL_TYPE_PULSE
entry.description: Pulsed radar: pulse detection, PRI tracking, gated IQ windows.

entry.name: ARRC_SIGNAL_TYPE_CW
entry.description: Continuous wave: tone found by FFT (or at cw_offset_hz), power and phase over blocks of samples, periodic IQ snapshots recorded.

enum.name: ARRC_DETECTOR
enum.description: Pulse detector of the standard measurement (signal PULSE).

entry.name: ARRC_DETECTOR_MF
entry.description: Matched filter with the waveform template.

entry.name: ARRC_DETECTOR_ENVELOPE
entry.description: Moving power sum over the pulse length, no waveform template; also used when no waveform is selected.

enum.name: ARRC_AVG_MODE
enum.description: How pulses or samples are grouped into one averaged block (avg_n, avg_time_s).

entry.name: ARRC_AVG_MODE_PULSES
entry.description: Average N pulses.

entry.name: ARRC_AVG_MODE_SAMPLES
entry.description: Average N samples.

entry.name: ARRC_AVG_MODE_TIME
entry.description: Average over a time window.

enum.name: ARRC_THRESHOLD_MODE
enum.description: How the pulse detection threshold is set (ARRC_SDR_MEAS_CONFIG threshold).

entry.name: ARRC_THRESHOLD_MODE_FIXED_DB
entry.description: Fixed level in dB above the noise floor.

entry.name: ARRC_THRESHOLD_MODE_CA_CFAR
entry.description: Cell-averaging CFAR, threshold is the false-alarm probability.

enum.name: ARRC_REC_MODE
enum.description: What raw IQ a recording stores besides the measurement tables.

entry.name: ARRC_REC_MODE_OFF
entry.description: Recordings hold the measurement tables only, no raw IQ windows.

entry.name: ARRC_REC_MODE_GATED
entry.description: Recordings also hold the raw IQ windows around each pulse (pulse mode) or periodic CW snapshots.

enum.name: ARRC_GATE_MODE
enum.description: How pulse times are chosen for measuring and for the gated IQ windows.

entry.name: ARRC_GATE_MODE_DETECT
entry.description: Gate around detected pulses only.

entry.name: ARRC_GATE_MODE_PRI_TRACK
entry.description: Gate at detected and predicted pulse times (tracks the PRI).

entry.name: ARRC_GATE_MODE_FIXED_PRI
entry.description: Gate at the configured PRF, aligned by the first detection.

enum.name: ARRC_PHASE_REF
enum.description: Reference of the co-pol phase phi_c in ARRC_SDR_MEAS.

entry.name: ARRC_PHASE_REF_NONE
entry.description: phi_c has no reference.

entry.name: ARRC_PHASE_REF_SELF
entry.description: Single channel, relative to the first pulse of the block (not a pattern phase).

entry.name: ARRC_PHASE_REF_COPOL
entry.description: Relative to the co-pol channel (differential phase).

entry.name: ARRC_PHASE_REF_REF
entry.description: Relative to the reference channel.

enum.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS
enum.description: Flags of a measurement (ARRC_SDR_MEAS, ARRC_SENSOR_RAW).

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_VALID
entry.description: pwr_c and phi_c are a measurement: pulses or samples were averaged and the power is above the noise.

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_XPOL_VALID
entry.description: pwr_x and phi_x are valid (an XPOL channel with power above the noise).

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_SATURATED
entry.description: I or Q exceeded 95 % of full scale in an averaged window.

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_OVERRUN
entry.description: Samples were lost (RX overrun) since the previous message.

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_TX_ACTIVE
entry.description: The companion was transmitting.

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_CAL_APPLIED
entry.description: A calibration table of the co-pol port converted dBFS to dBm.

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_TIMESYNC_OK
entry.description: time_usec is on the autopilot boot clock (time sync in effect).

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_PARTIAL
entry.description: Fewer pulses or samples than configured.

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_NOISE_CORRECTED
entry.description: Noise power subtracted from the powers (noise_correct).

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_PREDICTED
entry.description: Includes predicted (undetected) pulses.

entry.name: ARRC_MEAS_FLAGS_SIMULATED
entry.description: Simulated device, not RF.

enum.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE
enum.description: Content of an ARRC_SDR_TRACE, requested with MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE (param2 = trace type).

entry.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE_SPECTRUM
entry.description: Power spectrum of a co-pol block, dB per bin; x in Hz from -fs/2.

entry.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE_MF_OUTPUT
entry.description: Matched-filter output power around the last detected pulse, dB; x in seconds relative to that pulse.

entry.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE_ENVELOPE
entry.description: Co-pol sample power around the last detected pulse, dB; x in seconds relative to that pulse.

entry.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE_WAVEFORM_I
entry.description: I samples of a library waveform at the SDR rate (param3 = waveform index, default the current template).

entry.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE_WAVEFORM_Q
entry.description: Q samples of a library waveform at the SDR rate (param3 = waveform index, default the current template).

entry.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE_IQ_I
entry.description: I samples of the start of a co-pol block, full-scale units.

entry.name: ARRC_TRACE_TYPE_IQ_Q
entry.description: Q samples of the start of a co-pol block, full-scale units.

enum.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_STATE
enum.description: State of a companion script (ARRC_SCRIPT_INFO, ARRC_SDR_STATUS).

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_STATE_IDLE
entry.description: Not selected, not running.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_STATE_SELECTED
entry.description: Selected (MAV_CMD_ARRC_SCRIPT SELECT), not running.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_STATE_STARTING
entry.description: Reserved; the companion does not report it.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_STATE_RUNNING
entry.description: Running: a plugin inside the engine, or an exclusive script owning the SDR.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_STATE_STOPPING
entry.description: Reserved; the companion does not report it.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_STATE_CRASHED
entry.description: The plugin raised an exception and stopped; the standard measurement continues.

enum.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_KIND
enum.description: How a script runs on the companion (manifest kind).

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_KIND_PLUGIN
entry.description: Runs beside the standard engine.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_KIND_EXCLUSIVE
entry.description: Takes the SDR over.

enum.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_CAPS
enum.description: Capabilities a script declares in its manifest (caps); informational, the companion does not enforce them.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_CAPS_NEEDS_RX
entry.description: The script declares that it uses the RX stream.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_CAPS_NEEDS_TX
entry.description: The script declares that it transmits.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_CAPS_RECORDS
entry.description: The script declares that it writes its own data.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_CAPS_FLIGHT_SAFE
entry.description: The script declares that it is safe to run in flight.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_CAPS_LIVE_PARAMS
entry.description: The script declares that it takes parameter changes while running.

enum.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE
enum.description: Modulation of a waveform file (file attribute waveform_type).

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_RECT
entry.description: Rectangular pulse; MAV_CMD_ARRC_WAVEFORM_GEN can generate it.

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_LFM
entry.description: Linear frequency-modulated chirp; MAV_CMD_ARRC_WAVEFORM_GEN can generate it.

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_NLFM
entry.description: Non-linear frequency-modulated chirp (from a file).

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_BARKER
entry.description: Barker-13 phase code; MAV_CMD_ARRC_WAVEFORM_GEN can generate it.

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_P4
entry.description: P4 polyphase code (from a file).

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_FRANK
entry.description: Frank polyphase code (from a file).

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_CUSTOM
entry.description: Arbitrary samples from a file (the default type).

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_TYPE_CW
entry.description: Continuous tone, stored as a frame.

enum.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_KIND
enum.description: What a waveform file holds.

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_KIND_PULSE
entry.description: One pulse, repeated at the PRF.

entry.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_KIND_FRAME
entry.description: One full repetition frame.

enum.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION
enum.description: MAV_CMD_ARRC_SDR_CONTROL action.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION_ENABLE
entry.description: Open the device.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION_DISABLE
entry.description: Stop and release the device.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION_START
entry.description: Start the stream (mask RX or 0), recording (REC) or TX (TX: needs mode TX/RXTX and an arm).

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION_STOP
entry.description: Stop the stream (mask RX or 0), disarm TX (TX) or stop recording (REC).

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION_RESET_SOFT
entry.description: Close and reopen the device, then restore the configuration and the stream.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION_RESET_HARD
entry.description: Reset the device (USB re-enumeration) and reopen it, then restore the configuration and the stream.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_ACTION_SELFTEST
entry.description: TX to RX loopback through the RFIC with the selected waveform (no radiation); the result goes out as a STATUSTEXT.

enum.name: ARRC_SDR_SUBSYS
enum.description: Subsystems a MAV_CMD_ARRC_SDR_CONTROL START or STOP acts on; a mask of 0 acts on the RX stream.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_SUBSYS_RX
entry.description: The RX stream.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_SUBSYS_TX
entry.description: Transmission.

entry.name: ARRC_SDR_SUBSYS_REC
entry.description: Recording.

enum.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_ACTION
enum.description: MAV_CMD_ARRC_SCRIPT action.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_ACTION_SELECT
entry.description: Select the script at Index (state SELECTED) without starting it.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_ACTION_START
entry.description: Stop any running script and start the one at Index.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_ACTION_STOP
entry.description: Stop the running script.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_ACTION_RESTART
entry.description: Stop the running script and start the one at Index.

entry.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_ACTION_RESCAN
entry.description: Rescan the script folder and send the catalogue (ARRC_SCRIPT_INFO).

enum.name: ARRC_RECORD_ACTION
enum.description: MAV_CMD_ARRC_RECORD action.

entry.name: ARRC_RECORD_ACTION_START_GATED
entry.description: Start a recording (trigger MANUAL) with the optional duration, size and label.

entry.name: ARRC_RECORD_ACTION_STOP
entry.description: Stop the recording.

entry.name: ARRC_RECORD_ACTION_SNAPSHOT
entry.description: Bounded continuous capture.

entry.name: ARRC_RECORD_ACTION_NEW_SEGMENT
entry.description: Close the current file and continue the recording in a new segment.

enum.name: ARRC_PROFILE_ACTION
enum.description: MAV_CMD_ARRC_PROFILE action on a profile slot (0-31), stored on the companion as a JSON file.

entry.name: ARRC_PROFILE_ACTION_SAVE
entry.description: Save the main and measurement configuration in effect to the slot.

entry.name: ARRC_PROFILE_ACTION_LOAD
entry.description: Apply the slot's main and measurement configuration.

entry.name: ARRC_PROFILE_ACTION_DELETE
entry.description: Delete the slot.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_ARRC_SDR_CONTROL
entry.description: Control the companion computer SDR.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_ARRC_TX_ARM
entry.description: Arm or disarm SDR transmission. TX also needs mode TX or RXTX.
entry.param: Disarm automatically after this time (0 = companion default).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_ARRC_SCRIPT
entry.description: Manage companion computer SDR scripts.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_ARRC_RECORD
entry.description: Control raw IQ recording on the companion computer.
entry.param: User label number stored with the data.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_ARRC_PROFILE
entry.description: Save, load or delete a stored SDR profile (main config, measurement config and port profile).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_ARRC_WAVEFORM_GEN
entry.description: Generate a waveform file on the companion computer at the current sample rate.
entry.param: Default PRF stored in the file.

enum.name: ARRC_REC_TRIGGER
enum.description: What started the recording in progress.

entry.name: ARRC_REC_TRIGGER_NONE
entry.description: Not recording.

entry.name: ARRC_REC_TRIGGER_MANUAL
entry.description: MAV_CMD_ARRC_RECORD (the GCS).

entry.name: ARRC_REC_TRIGGER_ARMED
entry.description: The vehicle armed.

entry.name: ARRC_REC_TRIGGER_TAKEOFF
entry.description: The vehicle took off again after a landing, still armed.

entry.name: ARRC_REC_TRIGGER_BOOT
entry.description: The companion's configuration records from start.

enum.name: ARRC_NAV_IMU_FLAGS
enum.description: ARRC_NAV_IMU health flags.

entry.name: ARRC_NAV_IMU_FLAGS_GYRO_HEALTHY
entry.description: Gyro healthy.

entry.name: ARRC_NAV_IMU_FLAGS_ACCEL_HEALTHY
entry.description: Accelerometer healthy.

enum.name: ARRC_NAV_GPS_FLAGS
enum.description: ARRC_NAV_GPS fields that are valid.

entry.name: ARRC_NAV_GPS_FLAGS_VEL_D_VALID
entry.description: The receiver reports vertical velocity.

entry.name: ARRC_NAV_GPS_FLAGS_ALT_ELLIPSOID_VALID
entry.description: alt_ellipsoid is valid (the receiver reports the geoid separation).

entry.name: ARRC_NAV_GPS_FLAGS_H_ACC_VALID
entry.description: h_acc is valid.

entry.name: ARRC_NAV_GPS_FLAGS_V_ACC_VALID
entry.description: v_acc is valid.

entry.name: ARRC_NAV_GPS_FLAGS_S_ACC_VALID
entry.description: s_acc is valid.

enum.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_MODE
enum.description: ARRC gimbal pointing mode (MNT1_ARRC_GMODE).

entry.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_MODE_ARDUPILOT
entry.description: ArduPilot pointing.

entry.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_MODE_PARALLEL_PLANES
entry.description: Parallel planes.

entry.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_MODE_HPOL
entry.description: Horizontal polarisation.

entry.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_MODE_VPOL
entry.description: Vertical polarisation.

enum.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_FLAGS
enum.description: ARRC gimbal pointing limits.

entry.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_FLAGS_ROLL_LIMIT
entry.description: Roll limited: pointing at the AUT, polarisation not aligned.

entry.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_FLAGS_PITCH_LIMIT
entry.description: Pitch limited: not pointing at the AUT.

entry.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_FLAGS_TOO_CLOSE
entry.description: Closer than the minimum distance: holding the last target.

message.name: ARRC_SENSOR_RAW
message.description: ARRC RF measurement downlink (autopilot to GCS). Latest power/phase from the onboard SDR.
message.field: Sample time on the autopilot boot clock.
Co-pol phase (see flags for the reference).
Cross-pol phase relative to co-pol (NaN if unavailable).

message.name: ARRC_CC_STATUS
message.field: Data session id (links autopilot logs to the companion data folder).
Free space on the data disk.
Hash of the MAVLink dialect the companion was built with.
CPU temperature (hottest thermal zone); 127 = no thermal sensor.
Size of the data disk (0 if unknown).
TCP port of the companion's data service (download and erase over Ethernet), 0 if off.
Companion host name, cut to 16 characters (no terminator when exactly 16): on Ethernet it answers as hostname.local.

message.name: ARRC_SDR_STATUS
message.field: Time until TX auto-disarm (0 if disarmed).
Duration of the recording in progress (0 when not recording).
Size of the recording in progress, all its files.
What started the recording in progress.

message.name: ARRC_SDR_CONFIG
message.description: SDR main configuration. Sent by the GCS with op=SET; echoed by the companion with op=APPLIED. TX shares the frequency, waveform and PRF.
message.field: Waveform file name (template and TX pulse).

message.name: ARRC_SDR_MEAS_CONFIG
message.description: Measurement and gated recording configuration. Sent by the GCS with op=SET; echoed with op=APPLIED.
message.field: Maximum feed rate to the autopilot.
Detection threshold: dB above noise (FIXED_DB) or false-alarm probability (CA_CFAR).
Range gate start after the PRI reference (0 = off).
PRI tracker coast time without detections.
Record one noise window every N PRIs (0 = off).
1 to subtract the noise power from averaged power.

message.name: ARRC_SDR_MEAS
message.description: Processed SDR measurement, companion to autopilot (targeted, nominal 30 Hz). Logged by the autopilot.
message.field: Centre of the averaging window on the autopilot boot clock.
Cross-pol phase relative to co-pol (NaN if unavailable).
Co-pol noise power in the measurement bandwidth.
Mean time of arrival within the PRI (pulse mode).

message.name: ARRC_SDR_TRACE
message.description: Chunk of a quantised diagnostic trace (spectrum, matched-filter output, waveform). y = y0 + dy * data[i]; x = x0 + dx * (offset + i).
message.field: Trace time on the autopilot boot clock.
Trace id (same for all chunks of one trace).
Index of data[0] in the trace.

message.name: ARRC_SCRIPT_INFO
message.description: Companion computer script catalogue entry (sent on request).

message.name: ARRC_WAVEFORM_INFO
message.description: Waveform library entry on the companion computer (sent on request).
message.field: First 32 bits of the SHA-256 of the samples.

message.name: ARRC_PORT_INFO
message.description: Port of a port profile on the companion computer (sent on request, one per configured port).

message.name: ARRC_NAV_IMU
message.description: IMU sample: the filtered values the autopilot logs as IMU. Autopilot to companion computer, for the companion's records. Sent once per new sample, at most at the interval the companion sets with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL, and only on that link.
message.field: Sample time on the autopilot boot clock.

message.name: ARRC_NAV_MAG
message.description: Compass sample: the field the autopilot logs as MAG (offsets and motor compensation applied). Autopilot to companion computer, for the companion's records. Sent once per new sample, at most at the interval the companion sets with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL, and only on that link.
message.field: Sample time on the autopilot boot clock.

message.name: ARRC_NAV_BARO
message.description: Barometer sample: the values the autopilot logs as BARO. Autopilot to companion computer, for the companion's records. Sent once per new sample, at most at the interval the companion sets with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL, and only on that link.
message.field: Sample time on the autopilot boot clock.
Altitude relative to the ground-level calibration.

message.name: ARRC_NAV_GPS
message.description: GNSS fix: the values the autopilot logs as GPS and GPA. Autopilot to companion computer, for the companion's records. Sent once per new sample, at most at the interval the companion sets with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL, and only on that link.
message.field: Time the autopilot received the fix (jitter-corrected where the driver supports it), autopilot boot clock.
GNSS time of week of the fix.
Altitude above the WGS84 ellipsoid (see flags).

message.name: ARRC_NAV_ECEF
message.description: High-precision ECEF position (u-blox UBX-NAV-HPPOSECEF): the values the autopilot logs as ECEF. Metres: X = ecef[0]*0.01 + ecef_hp[0]*0.0001, Y and Z alike. Autopilot to companion computer, for the companion's records. Sent once per new sample, at most at the interval the companion sets with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL, and only on that link.
message.field: Time the autopilot received it, autopilot boot clock.
High-precision part of X, Y, Z, in 0.1 mm.

message.name: ARRC_GIMBAL_POINTING
message.description: ARRC gimbal pointing solution: the values the autopilot logs as ARGM, plus the pointing target. Autopilot to companion computer, for the companion's records. Sent once per new sample, at most at the interval the companion sets with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL, and only on that link.
message.field: Time of the solution, autopilot boot clock.
Commanded gimbal attitude, earth frame (w, x, y, z).
Probe position in the AUT frame: x along MNT1_ARRC_AZTH, y left, z up.
Pointing target (AUT) altitude above mean sea level.
Pointing error of the gimbal's measured attitude (NaN if the gimbal does not report it).
Polarisation error of the measured attitude about the commanded boresight (NaN if not reported).
